title: A resting browser conversation's report card
description: GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/rest. Habitat's own report of a rest, shown before anything is started: reading it starts nothing. The person's typing wakes Pi (POST .../continue, idempotent) and the first message carries the same report to the agent. report.stopped is absent when the conversation does not rest. availability says how much of Taskfleet could be read; unavailable is not an empty inventory.
